name: patient_sex_is_male_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient's current sex is male.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current sex is documented as male.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current sex is documented as not male (e.g., female, other).
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current sex is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_years
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in years.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current age in years is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in years if it is known and documented.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_benign_prostatic_hyperplasia_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of benign prostatic hyperplasia.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of benign prostatic hyperplasia, as evidenced by a diagnostic claim.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of benign prostatic hyperplasia, or there is evidence of its absence.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of benign prostatic hyperplasia.

name: duration_of_5_alpha_reductase_inhibitor_prescription_claim_during_observation_period_in_days
meaning: Numeric variable indicating the total number of days of prescription claims for 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor therapy during the observation period.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined how many days of prescription claims for 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor therapy the patient has during the observation period.
when_value: Set to the total number of days for which the patient has prescription claims for 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor therapy during the observation period.

name: patient_has_undergone_administration_of_5_alpha_reductase_inhibitor_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone administration of a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor in their history.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone administration of a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor at any time in their history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone administration of a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor at any time in their history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone administration of a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor.

name: patient_has_undergone_administration_of_5_alpha_reductase_inhibitor_inthehistory@@identified_by_prescription_claim
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the administration of a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor is evidenced by a prescription claim.
when_true: Set to true if the administration of a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor is evidenced by a prescription claim.
when_false: Set to false if the administration is not evidenced by a prescription claim.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the administration is evidenced by a prescription claim.

name: patient_has_undergone_administration_of_5_alpha_reductase_inhibitor_inthehistory@@duration_at_least_60_days_during_observation_period
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the administration of a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor lasted for at least 60 days during the observation period.
when_true: Set to true if the administration of a 5-alpha-reductase inhibitor lasted for at least 60 days during the observation period.
when_false: Set to false if the administration did not last for at least 60 days during the observation period.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the administration lasted for at least 60 days during the observation period.

name: patient_is_continuously_eligible_for_months_prior_to_index_date
meaning: Numeric value representing the number of months the patient is continuously eligible prior to the index date.
when_unknown: Set to null if the continuous eligibility period prior to the index date is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of months the patient is continuously eligible prior to the index date.

name: patient_is_continuously_eligible_for_months_after_index_date
meaning: Numeric value representing the number of months the patient is continuously eligible after the index date.
when_unknown: Set to null if the continuous eligibility period after the index date is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of months the patient is continuously eligible after the index date.

name: continuous_eligibility_duration_prior_to_index_date_in_months
meaning: Numeric value representing the duration in months of continuous eligibility prior to the index date.
when_unknown: Set to null if the duration of continuous eligibility prior to the index date is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of months the patient is continuously eligible prior to the index date.

name: continuous_eligibility_duration_after_index_date_in_months
meaning: Numeric value representing the duration in months of continuous eligibility after the index date.
when_unknown: Set to null if the duration of continuous eligibility after the index date is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of months the patient is continuously eligible after the index date.

name: patient_is_continuously_eligible_for_6_months_prior_to_index_date
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is continuously eligible for a duration of 6 months prior to the index date.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is continuously eligible for the entire 6 months immediately prior to the index date.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not continuously eligible for the entire 6 months immediately prior to the index date.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is continuously eligible for the 6 months prior to the index date.

name: patient_is_continuously_eligible_for_6_months_after_index_date
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is continuously eligible for a duration of at least 6 months after the index date.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is continuously eligible for at least 6 months after the index date.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not continuously eligible for at least 6 months after the index date.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is continuously eligible for at least 6 months after the index date.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_malignant_neoplasm_of_prostate_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of malignant neoplasm of the prostate (prostate cancer).
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of malignant neoplasm of the prostate (prostate cancer).
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of malignant neoplasm of the prostate (prostate cancer).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of malignant neoplasm of the prostate (prostate cancer).

name: patient_has_undergone_operation_on_prostate_inthehistory
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has ever undergone any surgical procedure on the prostate in their history.
when_true: Set to true if the patient has ever undergone any surgical procedure on the prostate at any time in their history.
when_false: Set to false if the patient has never undergone any surgical procedure on the prostate at any time in their history.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has ever undergone any surgical procedure on the prostate.
